summary: Iteration 10 — full test of Task 2 MULTI-WAREHOUSE (мультисклад) + auto dish cost + /reports/stock-movement. New suite /app/backend/tests/test_warehouse_iter10.py (19 tests, ALL PASS): warehouse seeding (Склад Кухня is_default + Кухня workshop, Склад Бар + Бар workshop), warehouse CRUD via API (create/update keeps is_default=false, delete, default-delete -> 400 'Нельзя удалить склад по умолчанию', PIN-admin -> 403), GET /inventory stocks[] with warehouse_name and balance == sum(stocks) for every item, invoice with warehouse_id increases ONLY that warehouse + updates ingredient cost + duplicate number -> 400, writeoff per warehouse (decrement + over-writeoff and wrong-warehouse -> 400 'Недостаточно остатка', amount 0 -> 400), stock/transfer (source -, dest +, aggregate unchanged, transfer logged as kind=transfer with to_warehouse_id; insufficient/same-warehouse/zero -> 400 and no stock change; non-manager -> 403), automatic cost (auto from recipe with g->kg and ml->l conversion = 40.00, recompute to 60.00 after an invoice changed an ingredient price, manual keeps 123.45 and is NOT touched by invoices, switching back to auto recomputes), sale auto-write-off on POST /orders/{id}/pay decrements the KITCHEN warehouse of the dish's workshop (bar warehouse untouched, writeoff logged with kind=sale + kitchen warehouse_id), /reports/inventory (value=qty*cost, total_value, warehouses list, warehouse_id filter) and /reports/stock-movement (in_qty=6, out_qty=2, net=4, transfers excluded, warehouse filter isolates movements, empty date range -> []). Full regression: 173 passed / 1 skipped / 2 xfail / 1 xpass (0 failures). Frontend (manager admin@resto.com): /admin/inventory all 4 tabs + 4 action buttons + warehouse filter work; warehouse create/edit via UI; invoice/transfer/writeoff modals with warehouse selectors all post correctly and per-warehouse breakdown updates live; over-transfer shows the backend error toast 'Недостаточно остатка на складе-источнике (есть 3.0)'; Движения shows transfers as 'Склад А → Склад Б'; Menu cost-source toggle switches АВТО/ВРУЧНУЮ and disables the cost input, saving a recipe in АВТО produced cost 0.90 ₽ (3 шт Булочки x 0.30); Reports 'Склад' tab renders both tables with a working warehouse filter. Zero console/page errors anywhere. Found 3 real backend defects (2 proven by /app/backend/tests/test_warehouse_edge_iter10.py, 1 by a manual probe).

critical.issue: Deleting a warehouse that still holds stock deletes the stock rows but does NOT decrement inventory.balance -> permanent desync (proven: item with 5 kg on the deleted warehouse ends with balance=5.0 while sum(stocks)=0, i.e. phantom stock in every balance-based screen/report). Fix: subtract each deleted stock row's quantity from inventory.balance (or block deletion while stock != 0 with a 400).

warehouse_id / from_warehouse_id / to_warehouse_id are never validated to exist or to belong to the caller's restaurant. Proven: transfer + invoice to warehouse_id='ffffffffffffffffffffffff' both return 200 and create stock rows shown in the UI as warehouse '—'; a write-off on that bogus id also succeeded (200). This also allows pushing stock into another tenant's warehouse id. Fix: look up each warehouse with {'_id':..., 'restaurant_id': rid} and 404/400 on miss.

minor.issue: Sale auto-write-off has no stock guard: paying an order for a dish whose ingredient has 0 on the workshop warehouse drives that warehouse's quantity negative (-1.0 proven) with no warning/flag returned. Acceptable for a POS, but the negative should at least be surfaced (report/UI flag) or clamped deliberately.

Row 'name' for inflow comes from the invoice item payload (client-supplied, possibly stale) instead of the current inventory document, so the report showed rows named 'TEST' while the item is named differently. Resolve names from db.inventory by inventory_id.

The request model accepts 'balance' but the handler silently ignores it (verified: 2 -> PUT 99 -> still 2). Either reject the field or implement an explicit stock correction endpoint — today a wrong quantity can only be fixed via a fake invoice/write-off.

workshop_id is not validated (any string accepted) and nothing prevents two warehouses mapping to the SAME workshop; warehouse_for_workshop() then picks an arbitrary one (find_one) so sale write-offs become non-deterministic.
Returns find_one({'_id': inserted_id}) without the restaurant_id filter (harmless but inconsistent with the tenancy convention used elsewhere).

ui_bugs.issue: Escape key does not close any modal (Приход/Перемещение/Списание/Склад) — only the X button works; after a failed submit the overlay keeps blocking the page until X is clicked

Measure units are printed as raw English codes ('18 pcs', '5.6 kg') while the rest of the Russian UI uses шт/кг/л (Inventory page maps them correctly)
Date range still uses the native browser date input (mm/dd/yyyy + OS picker) instead of a themed calendar component — inconsistent with the dark Russian UI (pre-existing)

design_issues.screen: /admin/inventory -> Остатки with a warehouse filter selected
issues: Items with no stock on the selected warehouse render as red 0.00 rows with a red-tinted background, so filtering by 'Склад Бар' makes 3 of 4 rows look like alerts; consider hiding or de-emphasising items absent from the selected warehouse

action_items: DELETE /api/warehouses: adjust inventory.balance by the deleted stock quantities (or refuse deletion while stock remains) — currently leaves phantom balance

Validate warehouse_id/from_warehouse_id/to_warehouse_id against db.warehouses scoped by restaurant_id in /stock/transfer, /invoices, /writeoffs, /inventory (404/400 on unknown) — bogus ids currently create '—' phantom warehouse stock
Decide and document the negative-stock policy for sale auto-write-off (warn/flag or clamp) — pay currently drives per-warehouse stock below zero silently
stock-movement report: take the ingredient name from db.inventory, not from the invoice payload
Either honour or reject 'balance' in PUT /api/inventory (or add an explicit stock-correction endpoint)
Prevent/handle two warehouses mapped to the same workshop (unique constraint or deterministic pick) and validate workshop_id
UI: fix the 'АВТО из рецепта' badge overlapping the СЕБЕСТОИМОСТЬ label; translate measure units in the warehouse report; allow Escape to close modals
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2208 lines — split into routers (auth, catalog, pos, inventory/warehouse, reports, printing) before the next task; the warehouse helpers and reports are already hard to locate

adjust_stock() falls back to the default warehouse when warehouse_id is falsy AND blindly upserts, which is exactly why unknown/foreign warehouse ids silently create stock rows — validate the warehouse once at the API boundary instead
transfer_stock() duplicates the stock $inc logic instead of reusing adjust_stock (intentionally, to keep balance unchanged) — extract a move_stock() helper so the two code paths cannot drift
There is no unique index on db.stock {restaurant_id, inventory_id, warehouse_id}; concurrent upserts can create duplicate rows and double-counted 'stocks' entries

inventory.balance is a denormalised aggregate maintained by hand in 5 places (invoice, writeoff, transfer, sale, item create) — a single recompute helper (or dropping the field in favour of summing db.stock) would remove this class of desync bugs (see the DELETE /warehouses defect)

rca_of_the_issue: 1) delete_warehouse() does db.stock.delete_many(...) but never touches the denormalised inventory.balance, while every other stock mutation goes through adjust_stock() which keeps both in sync — so removing a warehouse with stock leaves an inflated balance (repro: create warehouse W, create item with balance 5 on W, DELETE W, GET /api/inventory -> balance 5, stocks []). 2) adjust_stock()/transfer_stock() upsert into db.stock by (restaurant_id, inventory_id, warehouse_id) without ever verifying the warehouse exists, so any string passed as warehouse_id becomes a new 'warehouse' (repro: POST /api/stock/transfer or /api/invoices with warehouse_id='ffffffffffffffffffffffff' -> 200 and /api/inventory shows a stock row with warehouse_name '—'). Mitigation for both: resolve and validate warehouses at the API boundary and route every stock mutation (including deletions) through one helper that also maintains the aggregate.
